# Notices

This project is a translation of `fitdistrplus` 1.2-6.

Upstream authors listed by the package DESCRIPTION include Marie-Laure
Delignette-Muller, Christophe Dutang, Regis Pouillot, Jean-Baptiste Denis, and
Aurelie Siberchicot. Additional utility code in the upstream package includes
GPL-licensed weighted-statistics work attributed there to Frank E. Harrell Jr.

The original package archive, DESCRIPTION, and NAMESPACE are retained in

release.
